newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ABSA TO OPEN REP OFFICE IN NEW YORK.
newsitem.headline: ABSA TO OPEN REP OFFICE IN NEW YORK.

text.p: Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd (Absa) said on Monday it planned to establish a representative office in New York to complement its broker-dealer operations in the U.S.
Absa said in a statement the move followed an extensive review of Absa's operations, financial position and shareholder structure by the Federal Reserve Board.

The new office would liase between Absa in South Africa and customers in the U.S., soliciting financial service business for Absa and providing information and advice on economic conditions and investment oportunities in South Africa, it said.
